description: inspire.lfrz.gv.at: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.lfrz.gv.at. Coverage: the area served by inspire.lfrz.gv.at. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: WLV Einzugsgebiet Lawine; WLV Gefahrenzonenplan; Wildbach- und Lawinenverbauung - Bestandsliste - Geodaten; Wildbach- und Lawinenverbauung - Bestandsliste - Dokumente. Formats seen: ATOM, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
